S0.1 states that refuting the eventual bound needs one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 and that the O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) bound gives limit zero, as at 381-386. The paper offers no body derivation.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: bit network, frames, labels and rank budget, shear interface, then the interchange recurrence. Next come the complex phase interface, packed row additions and the layer recurrence, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations, chirp, CRT, twist, exact recovery and the cost table with minimum margin 2kappa. It thins in a few places: the complex half of the scalar network and its deficit eta_c, the arithmetic-depth recurrence behind the guard width, and the intermediate error bounds (ring, complex convolution, chirp) that feed E_s. These are asserted or quoted, not derived.

steps.note: Banks X_a,Y_a indexed by triples of 3-subsets of [100], the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire, and m=h^3 (S1.1.3) are all stated. N is used as the number of X_a but never written as binom(100,3)^3.
S1.1.2 says a common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and edges cost only frame changes D_vD_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decrease at the central 3->4 edges, each losing h, are all stated.
S1.1.3.6 says rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels and treats the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
L=Ich, the sum of |Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b are given explicitly.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are both below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 is stated, and s<Wm follows.
The endpoint difference is I_m on every role, so Phi_{I_m}, that is H<-H+D, applies on every original row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, a rank-a shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and one invocation makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} (from eta_b>20·2^{-50} and log m<20) give F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central saving through S1.1: the fixed bank-exchange network, the frame identity, labels with the single central loss h, rank equal to dimension change plus the N rank-one source edges, the budget s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b, the 100/539 ratio giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many interchanges, and the recurrence giving O(e^tau) with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only thin point is that N is never written explicitly as binom(100,3)^3.
